description: Transcribe audio to notes (pitch, onset/offset seconds, velocity, confidence as JSON — not a MIDI file). Works from an uploaded audio_key or an audio_url — any public https URL, including a result URL from another doseedo job (a generate take, a stem) as it was returned. Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task (usually ~15–60s). For the KEY / tempo / chords of a whole mix use doseedo_analyze_song instead. Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running transcription — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio to transcribe (alternative to audio_key): any public URL, or a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it — no key needed.

backend.description: Advanced: force a transcription backend. Omit — the server routes by instrument.

beats_per_bar.description: With tempo_bpm: beats per bar for the beat-domain times (default 4).

chairs.description: polyphony="section": register codes per chair, as an alternative to roster.

family.description: Optional instrument family (e.g. "brass", "reeds", "strings") when the exact instrument is unknown.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

polyphony.description: Optional: "solo" (monophonic line), "poly", or "section" (a horn section — see roster/chairs).

register.description: Optional register hint for the instrument (e.g. "soprano", "tenor", "bass").

roster.description: polyphony="section": the chairs on the stem, e.g. "trumpet,trumpet,trombone,tenor_sax". Omit for the family default.

strikes.description: With tempo_bpm: also return the harmony_strikes attack grid.

tempo_bpm.description: Optional known tempo — enables beat-aligned note times.

want.description: What to return: "notes" (default), "f0" (the continuous pitch contour — frame-rate Hz values, for glides/vibrato/intonation), or both.

name: doseedo_transcribe
